name: Notchy
description: Droppy for GNOME: the top-bar clock grows into an island for media (with AirPlay and AirPods), files with a real context menu, clipboard and calendar, a local Raycast-like launcher (Thunderstorm) with file search through GNOME LocalSearch, snap layouts for windows dragged into the notch, and fronts AirDrop on MediaTek Wi-Fi.
